feature_families.name: birth_and_advancement
feature_families.features: Race/class selection, point-buy/rolling, stats, age/history, equipment, leveling, spell learning and titles.

feature_families.name: turns_and_commands
feature_families.features: Energy/speed scheduling, command queue and repetition, walking/running/pathfinding, rest, terrain interaction and world updates.

feature_families.name: dungeon_and_perception
feature_families.features: Town/dungeon generation, profiles, pits/rooms/vaults, stairs, grids, lighting, line of sight, visibility, exploration and targeting.

feature_families.name: combat_and_projectiles
feature_families.features: Player melee/shoot/throw, monster blows, criticals, brands/slays, armor, damage, resistances and projections.

feature_families.name: monsters_and_lore
feature_families.features: Generation, movement/AI, groups, summoning, timed states, spellcasting, drops, uniques, kills, recall and knowledge.

feature_families.name: objects_inventory_and_knowledge
feature_families.features: Kinds/flavors, stacking/gear/equipment, charging/use, identification/runes, curses, artifacts/random artifacts, ego items, ignoring and inscriptions.

feature_families.name: magic_effects_and_status
feature_families.features: Class/book/realm spells, activations, effect chains/dice/expressions, status grades, healing/food, damage and player shape changes.

feature_families.name: stores_and_economy
feature_families.features: All eight stores, home, owners, buying/selling/pricing, stock and turnover.

feature_families.name: traps_and_chests
feature_families.features: Floor traps, glyphs/webs, chest traps, disarm/open/close/tunnel, trap saving and damage.

feature_families.name: quests_death_and_victory
feature_families.features: Sauron/Morgoth quest rules, dungeon feelings, death/retirement/victory, score/history and record presentation.

feature_families.name: ui_commands_help_settings
feature_families.features: Original/roguelike keysets, all visible/hidden/debug command families, messages, lists, knowledge, options, help, preferences and menus.

feature_families.name: persistence_rng_and_platform
feature_families.features: Upstream saves/load validation, RNG, data parsers, terminal/event handling and all native frontends; browser adapters must preserve rules.

scope_note: Source-backed feature index and content census; these are upstream capabilities, not a claim that any port implements them.
